in FHIR R4.

Across FHIR versions, the element set has been mapped as:
* R5 `GenomicStudy.analysis` 0..* `BackboneElement`

Element `GenomicStudy.analysis` is not mapped to FHIR R4, since FHIR R5 `GenomicStudy` is not mapped.
